response.rationale: The order status is "processing" and days_since_delivery is null, meaning the item has not yet been delivered. The standard return window rules (RET-007/RET-008) are keyed to days since delivery, which cannot be evaluated as true because delivery has not occurred. No condition in the candidate rules is satisfied on these facts: final_sale is False (so RET-012 does not apply), defective is False (RET-020 inapplicable), category is apparel not electronics (RET-002/RET-003 inapplicable), and goodwill_grant/fraud_hold are False. Since no eligibility rule's condition is actually true, the return cannot be granted at this stage; the customer may return within 30 days once the item is delivered.
